DBA iteratively reweights based on residual patterns across horizons; different mechanism than static median/mean/trimmed_mean that dominate the top-3. With unstable ranking (tau=0.197) and trend-dominated regime, adaptive reweighting may capture per-horizon structure that fixed order statistics miss.

Median of top-3 catboost trend-trackers; trend_strength=0.9068 implies high concordance among these 3, so the middle value is tighter than 7-model median where weaker models add spread
